notes.title: 1.0.1Hotfix
notes.notes:
1.Fixed an issue where CGs would not display after reloading a save in a room with CGs.
2.Fixed an issue where re-entering the bottom of the dungeon after triggering the dungeon event would replay the event, resulting in being trapped in a prison cell.
